programme.title: Força Em Alerta 2
programme.desc: Casey Ryback parte de férias com a sobrinha num comboio do Colorado a Los Angeles, só que, logo no início da viagem, um grupo de terroristas invade o veiculo para usá-lo como quartel general na captura de um satélite altamente secreto e extraordinariamente destrutivo.

programme.title: Million Dollar Baby - Sonhos Vencidos
programme.desc: Frankie Dunn sempre treinou boxeurs e a mais importante de todas as lições que lhes ensina é aquela que aplica na sua vida: protege-te a ti mesmo! Mas quando Maggie lhe surge no ginásio a pedir que ele a treine, ele está longe de adivinhar o desafio que ambos terão de enfrentar…

programme.title: Hardcore
programme.desc: Henry é ressuscitado da morte sem memória do seu passado e tem de salvar a sua mulher de um senhor da guerra com poderes de telecinesia, um exército de mercenários e um plano para dominar o mundo.

programme.title: Wilde
programme.desc: A história de Oscar Wilde, o genial poeta e dramaturgo, que vê a sua vida virada do avesso quando percebe que é homossexual.

programme.title: Perdidos E Achados
programme.desc: Mário, um funcionário de um armazém de perdidos e achados, encontra uma mala com os restos mortais de um bebé. A sua investigação leva-o a uma perigosa rede de prostituição e tráfico.

programme.title: Faz-Me Voar
programme.desc: Thomas é um “bon vivant” que só faz disparates mas que tem bons princípios. Cansado das sua desventuras, o seu pai, o Dr. Reinhard, decide força-lo a aprender uma lição ao cuidar de um dos seus jovens pacientes, um menino deficiente de 12 anos.

programme.title: Vencer A Qualquer Preço
programme.desc: Um jornalista irlandês da área desportiva tem a forte suspeita de que as prestações do ciclista Lance Armstrong nas vitórias da Volta à França foram conseguidas à base de substâncias proibidas, o que o leva a procurar pistas que hão de revelar toda a verdade sobre o atleta.

programme.title: Os Três Mosqueteiros
programme.desc: Ao lado de um jovem recruta ansioso por proteger o Rei de França, três leais espadachins tentam derrotar o pérfido conselheiro real e a sedutora espia enviada para derrubar a coroa.

programme.title: Sentido Único
programme.desc: Freddy é um pequeno criminoso em fuga com um saco cheio de dinheiro e cocaína. Ainda por cima, está gravemente ferido e tenta sobreviver a bordo de um autocarro, contra tudo e contra todos.

programme.title: Ava
programme.desc: Ava é uma assassina a soldo de uma organização secreta, que viaja por todo mundo com a missão de abater alvos VIP. Quando um desses trabalhos corre mal, Ava é obrigada a lutar pela sua sobrevivência e a enfrentar os fantasmas do passado…

programme.title: Moonfall Rota De Colisão
programme.desc: Uma força misteriosa tira a Lua da sua órbita em torno da Terra e envia-a numa rota de colisão capaz de aniquilar a vida como a conhecemos. Semanas antes do impacto, três heróis improváveis vão lançar-se numa última missão no espaço, e descobrem que a nossa Lua não é o que pensávamos que era.

programme.title: Stargate
programme.desc: O arqueólogo Daniel Jackson descobre como fazer funcionar um portal estelar descoberto debaixo de uma pirâmide. O coronel Jonathan ´Jack´ O´Neil recebe a missão de acompanhar Jackson e uma pequena equipa de soldados americanos através do stargate para explorar a galáxia desconhecida do outro lado.

programme.title: Terramoto
programme.desc: Quando um terremoto devastador destrói boa parte de Los Angeles, várias pessoas vão da o tudo por tudo para tentar sobreviver à catástrofe.

programme.title: O Batedor
programme.desc: Atormentado pelas mortes que testemunhou no Kosovo, Aaron Hallam tornou-se um assassino de topo das forças especiais... renegado. Quando caçadores furtivos surgem chacinados, ele lança-se num mortífero jogo do gato e do rato, que se estende das áreas rurais do Oregon à selva de cimento da cidade.

programme.title: O Capanga: Vingança
programme.desc: Pat Tate lança-se numa cruzada para vingar a morte violenta do seu amigo durante um assalto, mergulhando no lado negro do Soho nos anos 90.

programme.title: O Hóspede
programme.desc: David é um soldado que se apresenta à família Peterson como amigo próximo do seu filho, que morreu em combate. Só que após acolher o jovem em casa, o casal começa a aperceber-se que há uma série de mortes que começam a assombrar a cidade, e que parecem estar todas ligadas à sua presença.

programme.title: Butcher's Crossing: Cruzamento Do Carniceiro
programme.desc: Em 1874, Will Andrews deixa a faculdade de Harvard rumo a Butcher’s Crossing, uma cidadezinha do Kansas, para se juntar a uma equipa de caçadores de bisontes. Mas a visão romântica que tinha da tarefa vai sofrer um duro revés quando a sua vida e a sua sanidade vão ser colocadas seriamente em risco.

programme.title: Diabolik
programme.desc: A história sombria e romântica do primeiro encontro entre o mestre ladrão Diabolik e a sedutora Eva Kant, no final da década de 1960, com o inspetor Ginko determinado a acabar com os planos do larápio, que desta feita tenta roubar um valioso diamante.

programme.title: Mark Felt - O Homem Que Derrubou A Casa Branca
programme.desc: Esta é a história do anónimo mais famoso da história americana: Mark Felt, o vice-presidente do FBI que foi o “Garganta Funda”, o denunciante secreto que ajudou os jornalistas Bob Woodward e Carl Bernstein a revelarem o escândalo Watergate em 1972.

programme.title: Pé De Cabra
programme.desc: Janet é uma dona de casa aterrorizada psicologicamente por um empreiteiro manipulador, levando a uma batalha distorcida de inteligências com resultados deliciosamente inesperados.

programme.title: Terramoto
programme.desc: Quando um terremoto devastador destrói boa parte de Los Angeles, várias pessoas vão da o tudo por tudo para tentar sobreviver à catástrofe.

programme.title: Call Jane Tu Não Estás Só
programme.desc: Na Chicago dos anos 60, uma mulher casada e feliz vê sua vida virada do avesso quando tem uma gravidez que coloca um sério risco à sua própria vida. Sem hipótese de a interromper de forma legal, ela acaba por entrar em contacto com um grupo de mulheres que lhe oferece ajuda, as “Jane”.

programme.title: Machete Mata
programme.desc: O governo dos EUA recruta Machete para uma missão no México para deter um revolucionário psicopata que quer lançar um míssil nuclear em Washington.

programme.title: A Armadilha
programme.desc: Virginia ´Gin´ Baker é uma investigadora de uma empresa de seguros enviada para perseguir e ajudar a capturar Robert MacDougal, um ladrão profissional especializado em arte.

programme.title: Dog: A Aventura De Uma Vida
programme.desc: Briggs, um ex-ranger do exército, é encarregue de conduzir Lulu, um pastor belga militar de comportamento agressivo, pela costa do Pacífico até ao funeral do seu dono, numa jornada em que ambos terão de lidar com os traumas do seu passado e encontrar um ponto de equilíbrio.

programme.title: As Aventuras Do Dr. Dolittle
programme.desc: John Dolittle é um médico que consegue falar com animais e se lança numa aventura para encontrar uma ilha lendária com um jovem aprendiz e uma tripulações de estranha bicharada.

programme.title: Panamá
programme.desc: Em 1989, numa época de turbulência profunda no Panamá, o ex-marine James Becker chega à paisana ao país para negociar um acordo que envolve armas de fogo, mas acaba por se ver envolvido na invasão americana do país e aprende uma lição fundamental sobre a natureza do poder político.

programme.title: A Memória De Um Assassino
programme.desc: Alex Lewis é um assassino profissional que se recusa a completar a missão de matar uma criança, o que o torna num alvo a abater. A sua única hipótese é perseguir aqueles que o querem matar, só que ele tem um desafio quase inultrapassável: está a perder a memória a um ritmo cada vez mais acelerado.

programme.title: The Reckoning - O Derradeiro Julgamento
programme.desc: A Grande Peste espalhou no país um clima de medo, desconfiança e morte. Grace, uma jovem viúva, é falsamente acusada de bruxaria pelo senhorio depois deste a tentar forçar a pagar as dívidas com favores sexuais. Levada para a prisão, ela enfrentará a mais cruel tortura, mas não estará sozinha...

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Iolanta
programme.desc: ‘Iolanta’ and ‘Perséphone’ – A double bill consisting of two stage works that “represent an ideal of beauty, poetry and hope” forms this new production by Peter Sellars in Madrid from the Teatro Real from 2012. In both works, the progression from darkness to light acts as an initiation rite that completely transforms the existential attitude of the leading characters.

programme.title: Waldbühne 1999 - A Romantic Opera Night
programme.desc: This concert at the Waldbühne in Berlin celebrates the legacy of Wagner and his most famous successor, Richard Strauss. This concert features the Berliner Philharmoniker, soloist Ben Heppner, and is directed by James Levine, Metropolitan Opera's music director for nearly 40 years. Strauss's works on the evening program include Don Juan, op. 20; Cäcilie and Heimliche Aufforderung, Op. 27; Zueignung, Op.

programme.title: Discovering Masterpieces - Concerto for Orchestra
programme.desc: Watch the series ‘Discovering Masterpieces’, your audio-visual concert guide to the great masterpieces of classical music. The series brings you 20 half-hour documentaries on 20 classical masterpieces: acclaimed experts, famous soloists and outstanding conductors take you on a journey back to the time and place of composition. In today’s documentary, Bela Bartok’s ‘Concerto for Orchestra’ is discussed.

programme.title: Richard Strauss - A Hero's Life, Op. 40
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst leads the Cleveland Orchestra in a concert performing Richard Strauss' Ein Heldenleben, Op. 40. Violin soloist is David Radzynski. Recorded at Severance Hall in Cleveland in February 2023. Strauss, at the age of 34, sparked outrage when he cast himself as the central figure of his tone poem. Generally agreed to be autobiographical, the work contains more than thirty quotations from Strauss's earlier works.

programme.title: IVC 2021 - Semi-finals: Debussy, Schubert a. o.
programme.desc: Mezzo-soprano Ekaterina Chayka-Rubinstein (Germany, 1998) and pianist Maria Yulin (Israel, 1988) perform ‘Colloque sentimental’ from Claude Debussy’s Fêtes galantes II; ‘Die Geister am Mummelsee’ from Hugo Wolf’s Mörike-Lieder; ‘Bei dir allein’ from Franz Schubert’s Vier Refrainlieder, D. 866; Bart Visman’s Vermeer’s Gold; ‘La fleur qui va sur l'eau’ from Gabriel Fauré’s Trois melodies, Op.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Mozart - Eine kleine Nachtmusik
programme.desc: From the castle of Rammenau, the Gewandhaus-Quartett plays Eine kleine Nachtmusik, K. 525 (Serenade 13 for Strings in G major) by Mozart. This serenade was completed in Vienna on August 10, 1787, while Mozart was working on the second act of the opera Don Giovanni, and was not published until about 1827, long after the composer's death.

programme.title: Rimsky-Korsakov - The Tale of Tsar Saltan Suite
programme.desc: In this exquisite 2016 concert from Moscow's Tchaikovsky Concert Hall, the Russian National Orchestra and star-pianist Boris Berezovsky are led by conductor Mikhail Pletnev in a performance of magnificent works by Nikolai Rimsky-Korsakov. Winner of the 1990 International Tchaikovsky Competition in Moscow, Berezovsky interprets the works of Rimsky-Korsakov with a virtuosic power.

programme.title: Schubert - Winterreise
programme.desc: Baritone Samuel Hasselhorn and pianist Daniel Heide perform Franz Schubert’s song cycle Winterreise (‘Winter’s journey’). The 30-year-old Schubert wrote this masterpiece in 1827, just a year before his death. Like Schubert’s earlier song cycle Die schöne Müllerin (1823), Winterreise is a setting of the poetry of Wilhelm Müller (1794-1827).

programme.title: IVC 2021 - Semi-finals: Fauré, Tchaikovsky a. o.
programme.desc: Tenor Zhuohan Sun (China, 1993) and pianist Sara Pavlovic (Serbia, 1996) perform ‘Ehetanzlied’ from Alexander von Zemlinsky’s Sechs Lieder und Gesänge, Op. 10; ‘Nell’ from Gabriel Fauré’s Trois mélodies, Op. 18; ‘Net, tol'ko tot, kto znal’ (None but the lonely heart) from Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky’s Six Romances, Op. 6; Franz Schubert’s Die Mutter Erde, D.

programme.title: Behind the Scenes at the Zurich Opera House
programme.desc: The Zurich Opera House is one of the most renowned in Europe. Fifteen premieres are staged here every year - a significant achievement, when one considers just how much work goes into each individual production.

programme.title: Liszt - Sonata in B minor S.178
programme.desc: Works: Die Lorelei, S532, Sonata in B minor, S178. Pianist Mariam Batsashvili studied successively at the E. Mikeladze Central Music School in Tbilisi with Natalia Natsvlishvili and at the Hochschule für Musik Franz Liszt in Weimar with Grigory Gruzman.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Discovering Masterpieces – Symphonie Fantastique
programme.desc: Watch the series ‘Discovering Masterpieces’, your audio-visual concert guide to the great masterpieces of classical music. The series brings you 20 half-hour documentaries on 20 classical masterpieces: acclaimed experts, famous soloists and outstanding conductors take you on a journey back to the time and place of composition. In today’s documentary, Hector Berlioz’ ‘Symphonie Fantastique’.

programme.title: Villa-Lobos - String Quartet No. 14
programme.desc: Quarteto Radamés Gnattali performs Heitor Villa-Lobos's String Quartet No. 14 at the Theatro Municipal, Rio de Janiero, Brasil. The ensemble was founded in 2006 and consists of Carla Rincón and Francisco Roa (violins), Fernando Thebaldi (viola), and Hugo Pilger (cello). The quartet, which specializes in Brazilian music, focuses on educational activities.

programme.title: Beethoven - Triple Concerto, Op. 56
programme.desc: American conductor Leonard Slatkin leads the Orchestre National de Lyon in a concert recorded at the Auditorium de Lyon in 2014. The concert opens with William Bolcom´s Circus Ouverture, which was specially composed for Slatkin's 70th birthday. The concert continues with a performance of Beethoven's Triple Concerto in C, Op. 56 performed by three female soloists: Olga Kern (piano), Baibe Skride (violin) and Sol Gabetta (cello).

programme.title: Legato - World of the Piano
programme.desc: We live in a 'renaissance of the piano”, as the New York Times has recently put it. With virtuosic flair and an eagerness to expand the repertoire, a new generation of pianists has revitalized the instrument’s appeal. In addition to the usual classics, they perform formerly scorned works or discover neglected composers.

programme.title: PIAM - Final: Beethoven, Chopin a. o.
programme.desc: Acclaimed classical music talent scout Antonio Mormone (1930-2017) lives on as the name-giver of the Premio Internazionale Antonio Mormone (PIAM), awarded to the winner of the Italian music competition of the same name. The first edition of this competition, which was held in various venues in Milan from 2019 to 2021, was dedicated to the piano.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphonies and Piano Concerto No. 4
programme.desc: Iván Fischer leads his Budapest Festival Orchestra (BFO) in a concert program dedicated to the music of Ludwig van Beethoven. The program opens with the composer’s Symphony No. 1 in C major, Op. 21. Afterward, Fischer conducts Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 4 in G major, Op. 58, in which Richard Goode features as the soloist. The acclaimed American pianist (1943) is known for his interpretations of the Beethoven repertoire.

programme.title: Mozart - Symphony No. 35
programme.desc: Conrad van Alphen conducts Sinfonia Rotterdam in a performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Symphony No. 35 in D Major, K. 385, recorded at the Nieuwe Kerk, The Hague, in 2020. Van Alphen founded Sinfonia Rotterdam in 2000. Under his passionate leadership, this orchestra has developed into one of the Netherland’s best-known orchestras. Mozart’s Symphony No. 35 is also known as the “Haffner Symphony”.

programme.title: Prisma
programme.desc: The Mexico City Ballet (MXCB) is a contemporary ballet company made up of highly experienced international dancers, residents of Mexico City. In this gala performance recorded at Mexico City’s Teatro de la Ciudad, MXCB presents ‘E pur, si muove’ by choreographer Jaime Camarena, followed by ‘Prisma’ by choreographer Yazmín Barragán.

programme.title: Chamber music by Haydn, Chausson And Mendelssohn
programme.desc: Discover the next generation of chamber music talent from the Reina Sofía School of Music. In the first half of this program, Trio Michelangeli presents two masterpieces: Joseph Haydn’s Piano Trio No. 39 in G major, nicknamed ‘Gypsy’, followed by the romanticism of Ernest Chausson’s Piano Trio in G minor. The concert concludes with a performance by the Erinys Quartet of Felix Mendelssohn’s inventive String Quartet No. 2 in A minor.

programme.title: Symphonies in D by Mozart and Voríšek
programme.desc: Conductor Herbert Blomstedt and the Gewandhausorchester take us on a musical journey to the Czech Republic in this 2020 concert from Leipzig’s Gewandhaus. The program opens with Bohemian composer Jan Václav Hugo Voríšek’s Symphony in D major, Op. 23 (1821). Although the composition – Voríšek’s only symphony – was never performed during the composer’s lifetime, it has become one of his most-performed works today.

programme.title: PIAM - Semi-final II: Mozart and Bartók
programme.desc: Acclaimed classical music talent scout Antonio Mormone (1930-2017) lives on as the name-giver of the Premio Internazionale Antonio Mormone (PIAM), awarded to the winner of the Italian music competition of the same name. The first edition of this competition, which was held in various venues in Milan from 2019 to 2021, was dedicated to the piano.

programme.title: Mendelssohn - Violin Concerto, Op. 64
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the Berlin Philharmonic in the 2016 edition of the Europakonzert. This time, it takes place at the beautiful Baroque church of Røros, a Norwegian mining town whose intact picturesque old town makes it a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The talented Norwegian violinist Vilde Frang is the star soloist in Mendelssohn’s songful Violin Concerto, Op. 64, which she plays with warmth, elegance and effortless virtuosity.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Puccini - La Bohème
programme.desc: Gustavo Dudamel conducts the Paris Opera Orchestra and Choir in a performance of Giacomo Puccini’s La Bohème. Recorded at the Opéra National de Paris in 2017 and directed by Claus Guth. Among the soloists are Nicole Car, Aida Garifullina Atalla Ayan and Artur Rucinski. La Bohème premiered in 1896 at the Teatro Regio in Italy. The opera's libretto focuses on the relationship between Rodolfo and Mimì.

programme.title: Prokofiev - Peter and the Wolf
programme.desc: Mexican conductor Carlos Miguel Prieto leads the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería in a performance of Sergei Prokofiev’s Peter and the Wolf, Op. 67. Written in 1936, Peter and the Wolf is a short, narrated orchestral suite, telling the story of a brave boy named Peter, who lives with his grandfather on the edge of a forest.

programme.title: Rachmaninoff And Dvorák Trios
programme.desc: The Valerius Ensemble, consisting of Eeva Koskinen (violin), René Geesing (cello) and Ingo Lulofs (piano) plays Rachmaninoff’s Trio élégiaque Nr. 1 and the Finale of Dvorák’s Piano Trio No.3, Op. 65. Rachmaninoff composed this Trio in 1892 at the age of 19. The work does not have an opus number and consists only of one movement, which is highly unusual for a Piano Trio.

programme.title: Von Weber - Der Freischütz
programme.desc: This unique production of Carl Maria von Weber’s ‘Der Freischütz’ was created to celebrate both the piece’s 200th premiere anniversary at Konzerthaus Berlin and the 200th anniversary of the famed concert hall itself.

programme.title: Barenboim: 50 years on stage
programme.desc: On August 19, 2000, the Teatro Colón was filled to the brim with spectators longing to hear Daniel Barenboim play the piano. Barenboim, who is currently best known as a conductor, started his career half a century ago as a child prodigy, playing his first piano recital at age 7. This concert celebrates the maestro's on-stage career.

programme.title: Discovering Masterpieces – Beethoven No. 5
programme.desc: Watch the series ‘Discovering Masterpieces’, your audio-visual concert guide to the great masterpieces of classical music. The series brings you 20 half-hour documentaries on 20 classical masterpieces: acclaimed experts, famous soloists and outstanding conductors take you on a journey back to the time and place of composition. In today’s documentary, Ludwig van Beethoven’s ‘Symphony No. 5’ is discussed.

programme.title: Elgar - Concerto for Cello, Op. 85
programme.desc: For over two decades, the Berlin Philharmonic has celebrated its creation on May 1 with the annual Europakonzert, which in 2010 was held in Oxford. Led by Daniel Barenboim, the orchestra and the young American cellist Alisa Weilerstein, who has attracted widespread attention for her passionate yet precise musicianship, perform a breathtaking rendition of Edward Elgar’s Cello Concerto, Op. 85.

programme.title: IVC 2021 - Semi-finals: Schönberg, Britten a. o.
programme.desc: Baritone Arvid Fagerfjäll (Sweden, 1991) and pianist Hikaru Kanki (Japan, 1993) perform Franz Schubert’s An mein Herz, D. 860; ‘Die Aufgeregten’ from Arnold Schönberg’s Sechs Lieder, Op. 3; ‘A poison tree’ from Benjamin Britten’s The red cockatoo and other songs; Bart Visman’s Vermeer’s Gold; ‘La mer est plus belle’ from Claude Debussy’s Trois mélodies de Paul Verlaine, L. 81; Gabriel Fauré’s Prison, Op. 83, No.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Bach – Musical Offering in C minor
programme.desc: The Kuijken Ensemble is made up of the three Belgian Kuijken brothers on flute, violin, and viola da gamba, as well as harpsichordist Robert Kohnen. The brothers don’t look alike, but their shared musical heritage is evident. Together, The Kuijken Ensemble are among the most distinguished present-day early-music specialists.

programme.title: Wagner - Parsifal Act I. Prelude
programme.desc: The 2007 Europa-Konzert takes place in Berlin, on the occasion of the 125th anniversary of the Berliner Philharmoniker.

programme.title: House of Dreams
programme.desc: House of Dreams is an imaginative concert designed by Alison Mackay. The concert is a magical journey to the meeting places of baroque art and music - five European homes where exquisite works by Bach, Handel, Vivaldi, Purcell and Marais were played against a backdrop of paintings by Vermeer, Canaletto, and Watteau. Stage direction by Marshall Pynkoski and narrated by Blair Williams.

programme.title: Bach - Cantata 'Ich habe genug', BWV 82
programme.desc: The film Jaroussky sings Bach And Telemann is a portrait of a very special vocalist, and of two exceptional composers. When Philippe Jaroussky - whose angelic voice seems almost timeless, not belonging to any one epoque or decade - sings works by Telemann and Bach, it becomes abundantly clear that the sheer emotional force and the purifying power of their music have not diminished over the centuries.

programme.title: England, my England - II
programme.desc: From August 28 to September 6, 2015, the Early Music Festival Utrecht was all about 'England, my England'. In line with this theme, presenter Lex Bohlmeijer takes the viewer on an intriguing journey through the England of the Middle Ages, Renaissance and Baroque, and relates this to the city of Utrecht.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Sonata No. 30, Op. 109
programme.desc: Can we get into Beethoven’s creative mind, especially in the last phase of his life, when he was coping with severe hearing loss? Tom Beghin’s new recording of Beethoven’s Piano Sonatas Opus 109, 110, and 111 is an artistic exploration of how Beethoven’s musicking was shaped by the work environment he created with the help of colleagues and friends.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Orff - Carmina Burana
programme.desc: Rodolfo Barráez conducts the Orchestra and Choir of the Academia de Musica del Palacia de Mineria in a performance of Carl Orff's cantata Carmina Burana. Soloists are Anabel de la Mora (soprano), Andrés Carrillo (tenor) and Daniel Cerón (baritone). Carmina Burana, composed in 1935 and 1936, is based on 24 poems from a medieval manuscript of the same name.

programme.title: Mosaïque Project - Canadian Piano Quartets
programme.desc: This very special concert event celebrates the diversity and richness of Canada through the eyes and ears of its people. Ensemble Made in Canada’s Mosaique Project features a commissioned suite of piano quartets by 14 Canadian composers, each inspired by a region of our vast country. Their album release and two-year National tour culminate in St. Catharines’ stunning Partridge Hall!

programme.title: Napoli - Music's forgotten capital -I
programme.desc: In the summer of 2019, the Utrecht Early Music Festival explored the musical legacy of Naples: a cultural metropolis of contradiction and solidarity. In the documentary 'Napoli – Music’s Forgotten Capital', festival co-curator Thomas Höft unearths riveting tales from this multi-faceted city.

programme.title: J. S. Bach - Arias, solos, and duets
programme.desc: Baritone Matthias Goerne teams up with violinist Vilde Frang, cellist Nicolas Altstaedt, flutist Stathis Karapanos, and harpsichordist Michaela Hasselt in this program dedicated to the music of J. S. Bach. They perform baritone arias from Bach’s most beautiful cantatas, as well as solo pieces and duets. On the program are Sonata No.

programme.title: Mozart - String Quartet No. 19 in C major, K. 465
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents.

programme.title: Francesco Durante Missa per I Morti
programme.desc: In the impressive Jacobikerk, artist in residence Marco Mencoboni will make Francesco Durante’s magnificent Requiem shimmer, with orchestra, soloists, two choirs, and a pair of French horns in the main role. With the breathtaking vocal control of soprano Valentina Mastrangelo – rising star of bel canto – this concert will be a highlight of the Festival.

programme.title: The Morricone Duel
programme.desc: This exclusive live concert production presents a unique selection of movie classics - from Sergio Leone’s iconic Spaghetti Westerns to modern mafia masterpieces by Francis Ford Coppola and the cult movies of Tarantino.

programme.title: Handel - Messiah, HWV 56
programme.desc: The Messiah (HWV 56) by Georg Frederich Handel, also known as “A New Sacred Oratorio”, tells the life and suffering of Christ: a story of passion, fire, and sacrifice. This is one of Handel's best-known works, which took only three weeks to compose this oratorio and its famous 'Hallelujah'. The work has immense popularity since its premiere in Dublin in 1742, and is often presented at Easter.

programme.title: Europakonzert 2013 - Prague
programme.desc: Every year since 1991, the Berliner Philharmoniker has given concerts in a different European city on each May 1st. These concerts have become known as ‘Europakonzert’. Every guest city has its own special cultural importance. These concerts have served two purposes: to commemorate the anniversary of the orchestra’s founding on May 1st, 1882, and to celebrate the common heritage of the Old World.

programme.title: Beethoven - Septet in E-flat major, Op. 20
programme.desc: The soloists from the Lucerne Festival Orchestra present Ludwig van Beethoven’s Septet in E-flat major, Op. 20, which is scored for clarinet, horn, bassoon, violin, viola, cello and double bass. This 1799 piece achieved great popularity during Beethoven’s lifetime.

programme.title: England, my England - I
programme.desc: From August 28 to September 6, 2015, the Early Music Festival Utrecht focused on England, my England. On the basis of the festival theme, presenter Lex Bohlmeijer takes the viewer in a two-part documentary on an intriguing journey through England of the Middle Ages, Renaissance and Baroque, and relates this to the city of Utrecht.

programme.title: Chopin - Piano Concerto No. 2, Op. 21
programme.desc: Antoni Wit conducts the Warsaw Philharmonic Orchestra in performance of Frédéric Chopin's Piano Concerto No. 2, Op. 21. Evgeny Kissin features as the soloist. This concert was part of the celebration of Chopin's 200th anniversary in 2010. Chopin composed the second concerto one year before the Concerto No. 1 and completed both works at the age of 20, before leaving his home country Poland and moving to Paris.

programme.title: Brahms - Symphony No. 4, Op. 98
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts The Cleveland Orchestra in this performance of Brahms' Symphony No. 4. This is the final of the composer's short selection of symphonic works. Described by music critic Malcolm Macdonald as one of the “supreme creative acts of the Romantic era,” Brahms' Fourth Symphony is endowed with a strong undercurrent of subdued melancholy. It seems to pine for an irretrievable past.

programme.title: Mahler - Das Lied von der Erde
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle leads the London Symphony Orchestra in Gustav Mahler’s poignant song cycle ‘Das Lied von der Erde’ (The Song of the Earth). Joining him are two of today's leading vocalists: mezzo-soprano Magdalena Kožená and tenor Andrew Staples. Written in the final years of his life, Mahler’s masterpiece contemplates the beauty of life and the sorrow of parting through some of his most personal and beautiful symphonic writing.

programme.title: Carl Orff - Carmina Burana
programme.desc: Santtu-Matias Rouvali conducts the Gothenburg Symphony Orchestra and Choir in a performance of Carl Orff's cantata Carmina Burana. Vocal soloists are Ylva Stenberg, Brett Sprague, and Olle Persson. Carmina Burana, composed in 1935 and 1936, is based on 24 poems from a medieval manuscript of the same name.

programme.title: Verdi - Messa da Requiem
programme.desc: Roberto Abbado conducts the Filarmonica Arturo Toscanini, the Coro del Teatro Regio di Parma, and four vocal soloists in an outstanding performance of Giuseppe Verdi’s Messa da Requiem, recorded at the Parco Ducale di Parma, Italy as part of Festival Verdi 2020. The soloists are soprano Eleonora Buratto, mezzosoprano Anita Rachvelishvili, tenor Giorgio Berrugi, and bass Roberto Tagliavini.

programme.title: Waldbühne 1995 - American Night
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the Berlin Philharmonic Orchestra, which plays pieces by George Gershwin and Leonard Bernstein as part of a musical celebration of Americana. This concert was presented at the Waldbühne in Berlin, a green theatre based on the amphitheatre of the ancient Greek city of Epidaurus which is one of Berlin's favorite outdoor scenes because of its enchanting setting.

programme.title: The 12 Cellists - Documentary
programme.desc: Directed in 2012 by Enrique Sánchez Lansch, the documentary The 12 Cellists follows the 12 cellists of the Berlin Philharmonic Orchestra. Since 1972, this group is a staple of the international musical universe. Whether they play classical music, jazz, tango or avant-garde music, these talented musicians invariably enthrall audiences with the wide range of unique and bewitching sounds they produce with their cellos.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 4
programme.desc: The program is introduced with a short documentation about Schönberg's Pelleas et Melisande, based on a text by Claudio Abbado. Every musical theme relates to a special colour appearing on screen. What has been so remarkable about Abbado’s Mahler performances is that their impact has never been achieved at the expense of the multiple sensitivities, subtleties and extreme sophistication.

programme.title: Benedetta
programme.desc: Itália, final do século XVII. Baseado no livro ‘Immodest Acts: The Life of a Lesbian Nun in Renaissance Italy’, de Judith C. Brown, que por sua vez é inspirado numa história real, Benedetta traça o retrato de uma freira católica que tem visões eróticas e religiosas perturbadoras, a irmã Benedetta Carlini (Virginie Efira).

programme.title: Língua Mãe T6 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: No ‘Língua Mãe’, Luís Represas sai em busca dos autores portugueses. Gente que escreve, compõe, pinta, encena, sempre no seu próprio mundo solitário, por vezes desconhecido de quem não vê TV, rádio, internet, exposições, passagens de modelos ou de quem não tem hábitos de leitura. De Macau a Timor, de Angola a São Tomé e Príncipe, de Cabo Verde a Moçambique, da Guiné ao Brasil, estes autores têm um denominador comum: a língua portuguesa.

programme.title: A Teta E A Lua
programme.desc: Uma história de amor envolvendo um homem, um adolescente e uma criança. Ela é Estrellita uma linda e sensual mulher, capaz de exercer um fascínio no sexo oposto e em diferentes faixas etárias. Maurice, o marido, Miguel um adolescente que sente o seu corpo ficar eléctrico sempre que lhe toca e Tete, um garoto que está doido pelos seus seios, pois os da sua mãe foram para o irmão mais novo.

programme.title: Língua Mãe T6 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: No ‘Língua Mãe’, Luís Represas sai em busca dos autores portugueses. Gente que escreve, compõe, pinta, encena, sempre no seu próprio mundo solitário, por vezes desconhecido de quem não vê TV, rádio, internet, exposições, passagens de modelos ou de quem não tem hábitos de leitura. De Macau a Timor, de Angola a São Tomé e Príncipe, de Cabo Verde a Moçambique, da Guiné ao Brasil, estes autores têm um denominador comum: a língua portuguesa.

programme.title: Mektoub, Meu Amor: Canto Primeiro
programme.desc: Amin, um aspirante a argumentista a viver em Paris, vai passar o Verão a casa, numa aldeia piscatória no sul de França. É uma altura em que se reencontra com a família e os amigos de infância. programme.title: Feira Semanal: Leiria

programme.title: Jazzed Out Tokyo
programme.desc: Jazzed Out proves that a jazz session can take place anywhere. Unusual locations, such as garage buildings, multi-storey car parks, street corners, subway trains, and parks, in several of the world’s metropoles, provide the setting for brief jazz performances. The sheer rawness of the metropoles merge with the musical creations of various artists in search of the perfect ‘urban stage’.

programme.title: BIRD - The Nest
programme.desc: Five promising musicians get together in Rotterdam jazz club BIRD’s artists-in-residence project “The Nest”. Over the course of seven sessions, these talents exchange ideas, work on their projects, and play music together. Following this period, during which record producer Jameszoo and music manager Jochem Tromp offer their coaching experience, BIRD and North Sea Jazz Festival’s fringe festival DownTown organize a tryout performance.

programme.title: Aki Rissanen Trio at Jazzclub Unterfahrt, Munich
programme.desc: Aki Rissanen's interest in jazz came after he started taking classical piano lessons. His deep interest in improvised music placed him among top jazz pianist in his home country - Finland. While composing and performing his own music, Rissanen has also collaborated with Verneri Pohjola and Dave Liebman, and today his name appears among the top European jazz musicians.

programme.title: MotorMusic Jazz Sessions: Linus
programme.desc: The MotorMusic Studios in Mechelen, Belgium, attract many great musicians to the city. A wide variety of visiting international jazz musicians share their art of making jazz music with the DJAZZ series ‘Belgium Sessions’. In these sessions, some of Europe’s finest musicians perform their own, original music.

programme.title: Live at Studio de l'Ermitage, Paris
programme.desc: Five-piece contemporary jazz band Theorem of Joy released their first, self-titled album in April 2018 following three years of intense touring. During June 2018’s celebratory album release party at Studio de l'Ermitage in Paris, Ellinoa (vocals), Thomas Julienne (bass), Thomas St. Laurent (guitar), Boris Lamerand (violin and alto saxophone), and Tom Peyron (drums) perform repertoire from their album.

programme.title: Michel Camilo Trio - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: November Music: R. Frerichs/H. Alizadeh/Cello8ctet
programme.desc: The November Music festival in ‘s-Hertogenbosch, the Netherlands is the ultimate event for experiencing a broad range of music. It features a wonderful variety of contemporary and experimental pop, sound art, non-Western music, jazz and free improvisation.

programme.title: Saluzzi, Mariano And Dauner live in Stuttgart
programme.desc: Dino Saluzzi, one of Argentina's tango music masters, has been building his legacy since the mid-1980s. His accordion-like bandoneon defines Argentina's tango music. Saluzzi has explored many paths—paths along which he has rarely travelled more than once, despite some common threads.

programme.title: North Sea Jazz Archive: Wayne Shorter Quartet
programme.desc: The world-renowned North Sea Jazz Festival features a wide variety of genres, including traditional New Orleans jazz, swing, bop, free jazz, fusion, avant-garde and electronic jazz, blues, gospel, funk, soul, RAndB, hip hop, world beat and Latin. The festival was founded by entrepreneur and jazz fan Paul Acket, who sold his highly successful pop magazine publishing house to organize and fund the first edition of the festival in 1976.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Benjamin Herman
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Bayerischer Hof Night Club: Maria João Quartet
programme.desc: In this recording, the Portuguese singer Maria João makes her appearance at the Bayerischer Hof Night Club during the 1999 Münchner Klaviersommer. She is accompanied by Marcio Doctor (percussion), Miroslav Tadic (guitar), and her long-standing partner, the brilliant pianist Mário Laginha. Maria is known for her vocal flexibility and improvisational skills.

programme.title: Paradox Live: Rolf Delfos
programme.desc: Innovative contemporary jazz and improvised music, the search for modernity, mind blowing sounds, rock and pop… Indeed PARADOX Tilburg goes beyond jazz, crossing musical boundaries into the unknown soundscapes of electronic music. Indie artists, blues veterans and jazz superstars all pour their hearts and souls at the Paradox.

programme.title: The Morgenland Festival: VIVA!
programme.desc: Since 2005, the Morgenland Festival of Osnabrueck has dedicated itself to the fascinating music culture of the Near and Middle East. From traditional and classical music to avant-garde, jazz, and rock, the festival program also features art, such as visual arts, dance, and theatre of interdisciplinary projects. “Viva” is a perfect mixture of various instruments and musicians from all over the world.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Dionne Warwick live at the 27 Club
programme.desc: Dionne Warwick’s vocal artistry ranges from voluminous deep register to soft, fragile high notes. She masters the entire range with almost unnerving ease. But more than her strong, warm voice, Dionne’s magic is in the silky elegance and the secure delivery with which she tells a story.

programme.title: Marion Williams Sings Spirituals
programme.desc: You can’t help but be carried away by the powerful voice Marion Williams, who, with backing from Tommy Brown (piano), Joe Washington (organ), Billy Tuliver (drums), and singers Barbara White and Ann Bolden, sings gospel songs and spirituals as if she has lived them a thousand times over. The repertoire includes such familiar tunes as “Peace in the Valley,” “We Shall Overcome,” and “Michael, Row the Boat Ashore.”.

programme.title: Invisible World - WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. In 2018, WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria.

programme.title: PC Qwintett: 75th year of Courbois
programme.desc: Pierre Courbois has been one of Europe’s leading jazz musicians since the mid-sixties. This concert, recorded at the renowned Amsterdam jazz club Bimhuis, sees the drummer playing with his QWINTETT. On the occasion of his 75th birthday in 2015, Courbois hit the road for the Pierre Courbois 75 Years Anniversary Tour.

programme.title: Festival Vue sur la Relève: SHPIK
programme.desc: Montreal's very own jazz group SHPIK offers a bold and impressionistic music, drawing its inspirations from jazz, nature, and film. Evoking the great outdoors, self-discovery, and navigating between the immense and the infinitely small, this first album offers an intricate musical journey that is both energetic and reflective.

programme.title: Duke Ellington Orchestra - Het Concertgebouw
programme.desc: The Royal Concertgebouw in Amsterdam is a world-renowned concert hall, known for its first-rate acoustics. It has attracted many famous performers over the years and is one of the Netherlands' most treasured musical institutions. On November 2, 1958, American jazz titan Duke Ellington and his Orchestra performed two concerts at the Concertgebouw in Amsterdam.

programme.title: jazzahead! 2023 interview
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: TorTube: Tingvall Trio - Vägen
programme.desc: Jazz fans in television land have come to the right place for their dose of first-rate world jazz: TorTube! Jazz club De Tor in Enschede is one of Europe’s most authentic jazz venues, with an absolutely unique ambiance. Some of the best musicians from Holland and the rest of the world find their way to De Tor to perform for an appreciative audience of jazz fans.

programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. programme.title: Phalanx - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1985, jazz quartet Phalanx appeared at the festival.

programme.title: Identities. The Recording
programme.desc: ‘Identities: The Recording’ is a concert film about the recording of composer, arranger, saxophonist and band leader Karlis Vanags’s album 'Identities' with the Latvian Radio Big Band. The film shows all the album tracks as well as behind-the-scenes footage. 'Identities', which was recorded directly to analog tape without editing or overdubbing, won the Latvian Music Award for Best Latvian Jazz Album in 2020.

programme.title: North Sea Jazz Archive: Buddy Rich in 1978
programme.desc: The world-renowned North Sea Jazz Festival features a wide variety of genres, including traditional New Orleans jazz, swing, bop, free jazz, fusion, avant-garde and electronic jazz, blues, gospel, funk, soul, RAndB, hip hop, world beat and Latin. programme.title: Kurt Rosenwinkel meets Peter Beets Trio
programme.desc: The Dutch world-class jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats like Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson and John Clayton. From birth, Beets was surrounded by music: he heard classical music from his mother, who is a music pedagogue, and he heard jazz from his father, who has a great fan of Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey.

programme.title: Count Basie and his Orchestra live in Charleroi
programme.desc: Count Basie is one of the most important bandleaders of the swing era. With the exception of a brief period in the early '50s, he led a big band from 1935 until his death almost 50 years later. Basie's orchestra was characterized by a light, swinging rhythm section that he led from the piano, lively ensemble work, and generous soloing. Basie was not a composer like Duke Ellington or an important soloist like Benny Goodman.

programme.title: Brussels Jazz Orchestra: Changing Faces
programme.desc: This might come unexpected, but the Brussels Jazz Orchestra (BJO) is not the kind of jazz orchestra that sticks to standards. They prefer to achieve the highest level by composing original music, creating unique arrangements, and playing inventively as well as passionately. In fact, it really is jazz with a dynamic orchestral sound, with a classic strength in which each musician is also a brilliant soloist.

programme.title: Aretha Franklin: A trip in Paris
programme.desc: Live Recording at the Palais Des Sports from 1977. Aretha Franklin performs songs like ‘Respect’, ‘You make me feel like a natural woman’, ‘La vie en Rose’ and ‘Singing in the Rain’.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Amersfoort Jazz
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: If Only
programme.desc: Raul Midón appeared at 2017’s Sing Jazz Festival in Singapore with double bassist Romeir Mendez and drummer Billy Williams. Blind since birth, Raul Midón is a singer, guitarist, and songwriter from New Mexico. With a vocal range as dynamic as his guitar playing and a remarkable talent for trumpet mimicry, Midón’s performances transcend musical boundaries, effortlessly blending rock, jazz, folk, and Latin pop into his unique sound.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Burton And Ozone - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: Chamber music: Sissoko And Segal
programme.desc: Hailing from a long tradition of Malian kora players, Ballake Sissoko has worked with renowned musicians such as Toumani Diabaté and Taj Mahal. He met the French born Vincent Ségal by chance, and the two began jamming together, uncertain of what kind of music might result.

programme.title: The Streets of London: Jazz in The City
programme.desc: Short Documentary about Jazz in The City: London.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Liz McComb in Paris: Back to Blues
programme.desc: This film is a souvenir of an extraordinary concert. It reveals the true personality of Liz Mc Comb: more than a great gospel singer, she is a lover who dreams of sharing her generosity with us. Liz Mc Comb sings, among others, 'I'm Just a Poor Wayfaring Stranger' for all the immigrants in the world, followed by her famous 'Time Is Now'.

programme.title: Miriam Makeba Live at Estival Lugano 1985
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. Miriam Makeba, also named Mama Africa, was a South African singer, actress, United Nations goodwill ambassador, and civil-rights activist.

programme.title: Jazzed Out Swiss
programme.desc: Jazzed Out proves that a jazz session can take place anywhere. Unusual locations, such as garage buildings, multi-storey car parks, street corners, subway trains, and parks, in several of the world’s metropoles, provide the setting for brief jazz performances. The sheer rawness of the metropoles merge with the musical creations of various artists in search of the perfect ‘urban stage’.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Django Reinhardt Tribute: Beets And Rosenberg
programme.desc: The treasured compositions of guitarist Django Reinhardt, the founding father of hot club jazz, are engraved in everyone's memory. Although Reinhardt missed two fingers of his left hand, his virtuoso technique was unrivalled. Dutch guitarist Stochelo Rosenberg and pianist Peter Beets now have the pleasure to bring Django’s music back to life with their infectious improvisations.

programme.title: New Cool Collective Big Band at the Oosterpoort
programme.desc: New Cool Collective have been happily grooving on 24 years of fame thanks to their unique mix of jazz, dance, latin, salsa, afrobeat and boogaloo. As pioneers in the Dutch jazz scene NCC has received many awards and the band have toured the great expanses of Europe, Asia and North America.

programme.title: Julie Campiche Quartet at the Hafensommer Festival
programme.desc: The use of the harp in jazz is quite rare, especially in modern groups that also incorporate electronic effects. The combination of a harp with more conventional jazz instruments and electronic manipulation makes the Julie Campiche Quartet a unique ensemble in today’s jazz world.

programme.title: Belgium Sessions: Ben Sluijs
programme.desc: In this DJAZZ Belgium Sessions performance, which was recorded at AED Studios in Lint, Belgium, we witness Europe’s finest jazz musicians at work. A wide variety of international jazz musicians give a creative, up-close and inside insight into their art of playing jazz music. Young talent and established jazz musicians play to their heart’s content. Saxophonist Ben Sluijs received a classical training.

programme.title: Maceo Parker: Jazz à Juan
programme.desc: As a 25-year-old saxophonist, Maceo Parker played in the band of James Brown, but he is also known for his collaborations with George Clinton's Parliament-Funkadelic and Bootsy Collins' Rubber Band. Maceo has proven his star quality by creating a special chemistry between all the different styles of American black music. As a pioneer in the ‘groove’, he blends funky jazz with roots and blues with gospel. The result?

programme.title: Bergen Sessions: Karl Seglem
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Zyryab
programme.desc: This broadcast shows a rare appearance at the 1996 Germeringer Jazztage by the legendary flamenco guitarist Paco de Lucía and his sextet. Some may question the inclusion of a flamenco guitarist within a jazz festival.

programme.title: Avishai Cohen/Robert Sadin, Puncha Puncha
programme.desc: Double bassist Avishai Cohen’s trio with Noam David (drums) and Omri Mor (pianist) joined forces with the international Symphony Orchestra ‘INSO-Lviv’, conducted by Christian Schumann. On June 24, 2017 they brought Avishai Cohen’s signature blend of influences from Eastern Europe, American jazz and the Middle East to the Alfa Jazz Festival in Lviv, Ukraine.

programme.title: Be Good (Lion's Song)
programme.desc: Unlike many of his fellow jazz cats, vocalist Gregory Porter transcends the jazz bubble. After sustaining a shoulder injury, this former American football player turned to jazz singing. He was discovered in a Californian jazz club by pianist, saxophonist and composer Kamau Kenyatta. Porter lent his vocal skills to gospel choirs across the country and a string of successful musicals before turning his talent to his own compositions.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: The Morgenland Festival: The Art of Duo
programme.desc: Since 2005, the Morgenland Festival of Osnabrueck has dedicated itself to the fascinating music culture of the Near and Middle East. From traditional and classical music to avant-garde, jazz, and rock, the festival program also features art, such as visual arts, dance, and theatre of interdisciplinary projects.

programme.title: On The Road With Duke Ellington: I
programme.desc: In May 2014, the Conservatory of Amsterdam hosted a unique conference about one of the greatest jazz composers of the 20th century: Duke Ellington. Musicologists and musicians with a special bond with Ellington and his music spoke about his life and music. Among them were David Schiff, author of ‘The Ellington Century’, and Harvey Cohen, author of ‘Duke Ellington’s America’.

programme.title: Trio Chemirani: Dawâr
programme.desc: The veritable tombak virtuosos of Trio Chemirani, consisting of Chemirani Senior and Juniors, enrapture the Festival de Saintes. The tombak is a Persian percussion instrument, but its rhythms are universal. The Trio Chemirani’s music is accessible to all and will certainly resound with each listener. The members of the trio, Djamchid Chemirani (born in Teheran in 1942) and his two sons and pupils Keyvan and Bijan, are living in France.

programme.title: John Lee Hooker Live in Paris
programme.desc: In this 1970 performance at Maison de la Radio in Paris, France, American blues legend John Lee Hooker (voice and guitar) is joined by the masterful Carey Bell (harmonica), Joe Harper (bass), Lester Dorsie (drums), and Jimmy Dawkins (electric guitar).

programme.title: Vigil
programme.desc: Explore the music of one of the most influential and innovative saxophonists in jazz history: John Coltrane! Immerse yourself in this collection of remarkable performances from the early 1960s that showcase Coltrane's unparalleled artistry and unique sound during a transformative period in the artist’s career.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. In 2018, WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria.

programme.title: 10th Anniversary: JazzArt Orchestra And Friends
programme.desc: Jazz, funk, or soul: the JazzArt Orchestra tackles each genre without batting an eye. One of the orchestra’s ambitions is to cooperate with other art disciplines, and to contribute to the local cultural climate in the East of the Netherland. Recently, JazzArt has agreed with Odeon Theatres in Zwolle, the Netherlands, to play two concerts a year at the Odeon Theatre.

programme.title: Episode 1: Thelonious Monk - Jazz Greats
programme.desc: The idiosyncratic pianist and composer Thelonious Monk (1917-1982) is one of the all-time greats of jazz. His music went largely misunderstood for the first 15 years of his career, after which he was rightly hailed as a genius, and received credit as a founding father of bebop.

programme.title: SHYRE live at Festival Vue sur la Relève
programme.desc: SHYRE is the creative collaboration launched by Montreal-born vocalist and pianist Sarah Rossy. This five-member group mixes instrumental textures with ethereal ambience, taking the listener on a journey through passages of prose with unique aesthetics. SHYRE fuses pop-folk and jazz with symphonic timbres, and psychedelic ambience, employing lush strings, dynamic rhythms, and angelic harmonies.

programme.title: Episode 2: Dizzy Gillespie - Jazz Greats
programme.desc: American jazz trumpeter, composer, and bandleader Dizzy Gillespie (1917-1993) was one of the seminal figures of the bebop movement. He fuses all musical forms rooted in African culture, such as music from Cuba, Latin America and the Caribbean, into his music.

programme.title: Dave Brubeck Quartet - The North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. The Dave Brubeck Quartet gave an unforgettable performance at the North Sea Jazz Festival of 1982.

programme.desc: Tempo para relaxar e descontrair com sons e imagens da natureza que acalmam e transmitem uma sensação de tranquilidade. Pode ser um bom momento para adormecer ou simplesmente contemplar e descansar.

programme.title: Altas Horas - Ep. 1265
programme.desc: Serginho Groisman promove, semanalmente, debates sobre temas relevantes com a participação da plateia, artistas e personalidades de diferentes áreas.

programme.title: Três Graças - Ep. 121
programme.desc: Arminda disfarça quando Paulinho lhe pergunta sobre a Casa de Farinha. Leonardo flagra Viviane no bar com Angélico. Paulinho decide convocar Ferette para depor sobre a denúncia de Arminda. Gerluce avisa a Paulinho que irá depor na delegacia sobre o que sabe da fabricação de remédios falsos. Paulinho indaga Ferette sobre a Casa de Farinha.

programme.title: Três Graças - Ep. 122
programme.desc: Paulinho, Juquinha e Jairo tentam driblar o cinismo de Ferette. Gerluce revela a Zenilda que foi ela quem planejou o roubo das Três Graças. Júnior desconfia de que Kasper e Bagdá possam estar mancomunados. Bagdá expulsa Lucélia de sua casa. Vandílson se coloca à disposição de Lucélia. Paulinho entrega uma intimação a Gerluce para depor sobre o sumiço das Três Graças.

programme.title: Três Graças - Ep. 123
programme.desc: Gerluce chega à delegacia para depor. Zenilda tenta conter Gerluce durante seu depoimento. Ferette planeja usar Raul para incriminar Rogério pelos crimes da Fundação. Ferette comunica a Luciano que ele assumirá a farmácia da Chacrinha no lugar de Viviane. A delegada Marisa prende Viviane em flagrante.

programme.title: Três Graças - Ep. 124
programme.desc: Leonardo e Angélico discutem, e Viviane recebe apoio de Zenilda. Lígia reage ao saber por Kellen da prisão de Viviane. Joaquim sugere que Júnior passe um tempo na casa de Maggye para poder vigiar Kasper. Ao ver a bala de revólver que atingiu Bagdá, Kasper intriga o bandido quando afirma que o tiro que levou parece ter saído da arma de um civil. Vandílson avisa a Lucélia que Kasper está com Bagdá.

programme.title: Três Graças - Ep. 125
programme.desc: Arminda marca encontro com Joaquim no ferro-velho. Zenilda sente orgulho de Leonardo quando o filho se dispõe a ajudar o grupo de Rogério a acabar com Ferette. Arminda coloca Ferette para dormir com um sonífero dado por Helga. Júnior aceita passar alguns dias na casa de Maggye. Kasper fica assustado quando é convocado por Juquinha a depor sobre o roubo das Três Graças.

programme.title: Três Graças - Ep. 126
programme.desc: Joaquim percebe que foi dopado por Arminda ao constatar que as Três Graças sumiram. Gerluce tranquiliza Viviane. Os policiais notam diferenças nos depoimentos de Kasper e João Rubens. Juquinha encontra um fio de cabelo grisalho na máscara de Kasper. Josefa finge falta de memória em seu depoimento. Josefa confronta Arminda.

programme.title: Lady Night - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Tatá se emociona ao realizar o sonho de entrevistar um de seus ídolos de infância, Junior Lima. Mas, logo após a emoção passar, é hora de ele entender o que é estar no Lady Night.

programme.title: Explode Coração - Ep. 150
programme.desc: Augusto pede Soraya em casamento. Edu desiste da fuga e pede ajuda de Sarita. Vera encontra Gugu na rua. Edu se entrega para a polícia para salvar Sarita.

programme.title: Alma Gêmea - Ep. 24
programme.desc: Olívia faz um escândalo. Rafael vê Serena conversando com Hélio. Cristina se aproxima de Rafael. Dalila desmaia com uma notícia. Elias descobre o que Kátia aprontou.

programme.title: Malhação - 2014 T22 - Ep. 232
programme.desc: Nat chama pelo nome de Lobão. Começa a luta entre Cobra e Duca e todos estranham o andamento da competição. Joaquina estraga os planos de Ed e ele pensa em uma nova estratégia.

programme.title: Orgulho E Paixão - Ep. 14
programme.desc: Julieta e Camilo se surpreendem com a chegada da família de Jane. Susana provoca Darcy e Elisabeta. Ofélia comete gafes no jantar com Julieta e Susana comemora. Petúlia descobre sobre o amor de Ernesto por Elisabeta e revela a Susana. Uirapuru chega para o jantar na casa de Julieta e Darcy se incomoda. Brandão confirma a Ema que Jorge a ama. Ernesto e Darcy brigam e acabam causando uma explosão.

programme.title: Coração Acelerado - Ep. 102
programme.desc: Janete perdoa Alaorzinho, mas afirma que não reatará com ele. Walmir fica desconfortável quando Naiane mostra suas supostas fotos de infância. Zuzu admira Janete. Leandro apoia Eduarda, que hesita em aceitar o pedido de aproximação de Valéria. Ronei incentiva Zilá a se manter firme diante dos Amaral.

programme.title: Conversa Com Bial - Ep. 1547
programme.desc: Uma conversa não é feita apenas de assuntos. Saber falar, ter o que dizer, ouvir e escutar são igualmente importantes para a construção de um diálogo.

programme.title: Rainha da Sucata - Ep. 109
programme.desc: Maria do Carmo conta tudo para Paula. Caio descobre que Mariana e Renato irão viajar. Maria do Carmo recebe um bilhete misterioso.

programme.title: Império - Ep. 72
programme.desc: Maurílio questiona a viagem de Marta para o Monte Roraima. Tuane pede um emprego a Elivaldo. Maria Marta conta para o Comendador que está namorando. Leonardo beija Amanda.

programme.title: Passione - Ep. 60
programme.desc: Mauro vai ao quarto de Melina. Ele diz que ela não vai se casar com o Fred porquê é com ele que ela vai casar.

programme.title: A Nobreza Do Amor - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Dumi pede perdão a Jendal e jura fidelidade ao novo rei em troca de sua vida. Mirinho revela a Casemiro que deseja se mudar para Recife. Alika tem um sonho com o guerreiro que a salvará. Mirinho promete levar Mundica a Recife. Casemiro desabafa com Tonho sobre Mirinho. Mirinho presenteia Virgínia. Tonho conversa com Mirinho sobre as terras de Casemiro.

programme.title: Explode Coração - Ep. 151
programme.desc: Serginho briga com Beth ao cair nas armações de Alícia. Vera cuida de Gugu. Júlio usa o computador para pedir o perdão de Dara. Edu é surpreendido ao encontrar Yone na delegacia.

programme.title: Alma Gêmea - Ep. 25
programme.desc: Mirna arruma uma nova paquera. Elias dá uma sugestão a Rafael. Kátia se surpreende com um convite. Dalila confirma a gravidez. Raul se nega a pagar as dívidas de Olívia.

programme.title: Orgulho E Paixão - Ep. 15
programme.desc: Elisabeta se desespera com o acidente e Vicente teme que Darcy e Ernesto não tenham sobrevivido. Soterrados, Darcy se recupera e consegue reavivar Ernesto. Elisabeta insiste para que Vicente continue as buscas por Darcy e Ernesto. Susana ameaça o Barão. Darcy e Ernesto planejam uma forma de se libertarem. O Barão ordena que Aurélio faça um acordo com Julieta. Susana acusa Elisabeta pelo acidente.

programme.title: Coração Acelerado - Ep. 103
programme.desc: Alaorzinho sofre ao lembrar do passado com Janete. Alaorzinho e Zilá contam a Naiane que irão se separar, e a menina se desespera. Naiane repreende Zilá por sua mentira contra Janete, e a mãe afirma que ela fez o mesmo ao inventar que é a menina do passado de João Raul. João Raul sofre ao ver Agrado com Leandro, e Luan nota. Naiane impede que Zilá deixe a mansão.

programme.title: Três Graças - Ep. 127

Josefa fica estarrecida ao saber por Gerluce que a cuidadora foi responsável pelo roubo das Três Graças. Arminda e Ferette recebem convite para evento na galeria de Kasper e João Rubens.

programme.title: Justin Bieber - Live at Madison Square Garden
programme.desc: The film follows the pop star Justin Bieber during 10 days counting down to his performance at Madison Square Garden. It also includes footage from his My World Tour, interviews with family and friends, a visit to his original hometown in Canada, and some of the story and videos of his childhood.

programme.title: Snow Patrol - Live At Somerset House
programme.desc: With their third album, 'Final Straw', selling a cool 1.5 million in the UK in its year of release, Snow Patrol's reputation as a remarkable band remains intact. 'Live At Somerset House' reveals why the band is praised for delivering fantastic live performances. It also places them at one of London's most gorgeous settings which complements the band's distinctive and provocative sound perfectly.

programme.desc: A selection of our best concert previews and exclusive interviews.

programme.title: Duran Duran - A Diamond In The Mind
programme.desc: A Diamond In The Mind Live was filmed at the MEN Arena in Manchester on December 16th 2011. This stunning Duran Duran live show is the perfect combination of great music, amazing visuals and iconic style which has been the band's trademark throughout their career. Following the release of their acclaimed 'All You Need Is Now' album, this concert combines new songs from that release with their classic hits.

programme.title: Robbie Williams - Live at the Apple Music Festival
programme.desc: A brand new show that brings a veteran artist at his best! The talented artist, who became famous in the group 'Take That', lacks presentations, but he himself begins his show by saying: 'Let me resubmit ...'. Robbie Williams has the ability to reinvent himself, exhibiting so much energy that he seems to be a rookie artist.

programme.title: Justin Timberlake - FutureSex/LoveShow - Live from New York
programme.desc: The FutureSex/LoveSounds album, which spawned the tour FutureSex/LoveShow, is one of the most awarded 2007 albums and has sold more than eight million copies worldwide. 'Sexyback', 'What Comes Around ... Goes Around', 'My Love', 'Summer Love' and 'Lovestoned' are some of the highlights and were among the most played of the year around the world.

Since releasing her first album in 2010, Ellie has traveled the world to showcase her talents, both in the voice and in the composition of her songs.

programme.title: Unitel Brilha Com As Estrelinhas (Semana 2)

programme.title: Família Dumbo
programme.desc: A Família Dumbo chega à Kanuca TV trazendo o retrato divertido e emocionante de uma família típica de Benguela, onde cada episódio transforma desafios do dia-a-dia em histórias cheias de humor, valores e identidade angolana. Entre confusões, gargalhadas e lições inesperadas, a Família Dumbo mostra que em cada casa angolana existe uma história que merece ser contada.

programme.title: Gemini 8
programme.desc: Gemini 8 é uma série animada que narra as aventuras de Marco, um garoto terrestre que, ao ser puxado por uma pipa através de um portal, é transportado para o distante planeta Gemini 8. Apresenta uma mistura de aventura e ficção científica, explorando temas como amizade, exploração e o desconhecido.

programme.desc: Mia enfrenta a realidade da violência doméstica desde criança. Quando tudo parece controlado, envolve-se num ciclo de relacionamentos tóxicos e abusivos. Receosa pela própria vida muda-se para um lugar onde o passado não a persegue... Mas nem tudo corre como planeado.

programme.desc: Programa destinado a todas as mulheres que desejam conhecer a vontade de Deus para a sua vida e família, temas diversificados que a vão prender ao ecra.

programme.desc: É o espaço noticioso diário que leva até si, de forma clara e imediata, os acontecimentos que marcam a atualidade nacional e internacional. Com uma abordagem rigorosa e acessível, o programa cedido pela TV Maná 1 à Kuriakos TV, destaca os temas mais relevantes do momento — da política à economia, da sociedade à cultura — garantindo uma informação atualizada e de confiança.

programme.title: Na Rota Dos Angolanos T2 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Programa de índole cultural onde se viaja à descoberta dos angolanos espalhados por todo o mundo, com reportagens produzidas não só em Angola mas também um pouco por todo o mundo onde se encontrem angolanos.Com uma componente humana e social sempre presente, faz parte integrante dos nossos objectivos traçados, a interacção com os angolanos, tornando assim o programa em muito mais do que uma colectânea de imagens.

programme.title: Superbook T5 - Ep. 13
programme.desc: Superbook ou Superlivro, é uma série anime produzida pela CBN nos Estados Unidos que narra os acontecimentos do Antigo e Novo Testamento da Biblia. Christopher 'Chris' Peeper, Joy e Gizmo (um robô) viajam juntos através do tempo e do espaço para conhecer as personagens do Livro Sagrado. Uma série sem vilões e cheia de histórias clássicas que todos conhecemos. Inédita nesta nova versão 3D em Português de Portugal.
